instruction: Please play the video stream from this URL for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_4x3/bipbop_4x3_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_4x3 variant). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC playing state via HTTP status.xml interface
Metric properly checks VLC state is "playing" before verifying URL
Metric has robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback methods for HLS streams
Metric handles HLS-specific cases where VLC may show only filename instead of full URL
Expected URL value exactly matches the URL in the instruction
Complete coverage: verifies both playing state and correct URL
State accessibility: VLC HTTP interface remains available during playback, no postconfig needed
The evaluator can semantically verify that the HLS stream URL is playing in VLC
